benchmark: Fixed public benchmark. The generator, seed and answer key are public, so this is not a blind test.

provenance.frozenNote: Version 2 gate rules were changed using the dev split only and committed before the held-out split was scored. The held-out split was then scored once with this version. Any later gate change is a regression check, not a new result.
provenance.testSplitSeen: The held-out split was seen once after dev tuning. Version 1 held-out results, including its failure list, were already public when version 2 tuning began, so version 2 held-out numbers are a second look at a fixed public benchmark, not a blind result.

swap.rule: Every swap run must fall inside the 95 percent document bootstrap interval of the key run.

metadataInvariance.rule: Same outputs after reversing order, fresh random IDs and a second call.

indistinguishability.method: Mask each planted edit as <ID>, take up to 60 characters each side on the same line, match with windows around random one or two word runs in untouched text, character 2 to 4 gram logistic regression, 5 folds grouped by document, 20 negative draws.

failures.rule: Severity order: missed planted identifier, partial leak, removed clinical keep token, source-left-in identifier not removed. Within a class, document id then position.
